charge_port.notes: Kia Canada guide (search excerpt): factory NACS ports start with the 2025 EV6; earlier Kia EVs have CCS1 ports.
Electrek: 2025 EV6 gets a native NACS port (so earlier model years are CCS1).

supercharger_access.notes: Kia US: CCS-port Kia vehicles may use Tesla Superchargers with a Kia-approved NACS-to-CCS adapter (access from spring 2025).
Kia Canada: adapters for EV6/EV9/Niro EV owners sold at Kia dealers (April 2025); search excerpt only.

wheels.notes: US Wind AWD 19 in; the Canadian Land AWD page was not read (GT-Line packages are separate Canadian trims).
